blurb: Accessible tab group built on Radix UI primitives with consistent styling.
description: Composable wrapper around Radix UI Tabs that exports Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, and TabsContent. Provides keyboard navigation, ARIA attributes, and a neutral styled tab bar with smooth state transitions.
use_when: Building accessible tab interfaces that need keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Home/End) and screen reader support…
avoid_when: When you need custom animation; the component provides basic styling only. Not suitable for highly styled or animated…
a11y: Full keyboard support (arrow keys, Home/End, Enter). ARIA roles and live regions managed by Radix. Proper focus management and screen reader announcements.
